title: Jeffrie D Probable NDE 4443
content: I had been playing and somehow my nose began bleeding. Mother had me in the bathroom with ice trying to apply pressure to get my nose to stop bleeding. NOTHING worked. I remember that as a last resort she got a butter knife and put it in ice and placed it under my upper lip in an effort to slow the bleeding. My dad was out of town on business, mom was home with four little ones and she had to have a neighbor take the two of us to the hospital. She held me on her lap and my nose continued to bleed. It had gotten dark and she pointed to the happy face in the moon (the moon was huge and bright)! We arrived at the hospital and a nurse sat me on the edge of a bed and removed the cloth from my face. She put a gown on me and pointed to the little bears printed on it; I looked down and immediately began throwing up blood and blood clots! They took me to a room and began trying to get a drop of blood from me to use to match the blood for the transfusion. They stuck my fingers, my toes, my arms, behind my knees - nothing. Mother stood at the head of the bed and she was crying and holding onto me and kept saying, 'Say it with me, Jeffrie - The Lord is my Shepherd, I shall not want...' and we kept saying the 23rd Psalm and The Lord's Prayer over and over. I kept watching the huge light over my bed and somehow I slipped off from the bed into warmth, wellness and felt happy and I was not afraid - didn't hurt; just drifting away. Suddenly it was as if something caught me and I opened my eyes and tried to move my left arm and couldn't because it was taped to a board with the needle delivering blood. I was SHOCKED because I had been away from there! I got much older and I was telling mother what I had experienced and that I remembered the gown, I remembered praying with her and I told her I remembered the big light over my bed and her comment: 'There was no light over your bed.' She had had her own Near Death Experiences, so she didn't discount anything I told her - she knew.

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: Return was described as 'something caught me' and he was suddenly back aware of his body with his arm taped and a needle delivering blood.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Severe uncontrolled nosebleed with vomiting blood and blood clots; required transfusion.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Experience included drifting away into 'warmth, wellness' and then abruptly being back in the body; no explicit 'choice' described.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: No tunnel/realm described; primarily a drifting-away phase followed by abrupt return to bodily awareness.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Perceived a 'huge light over my bed' during the crisis; later mother said, 'There was no light over your bed.'
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “somehow I slipped off from the bed into warmth, wellness and felt happy and I was not afraid - didn't hurt; just drifting away.”
